# Gmail
> Google’s email service for sending, receiving, organizing, and searching email across web and mobile.

Gmail is part of Google Workspace and integrates with Google Account, Help Center, admin, and developer resources for end users, administrators, and developers building Gmail integrations.

## Product
- [Gmail](https://mail.google.com/): Main Gmail web application for accessing inbox, composing messages, and managing mail.
- [Gmail Overview](https://www.google.com/gmail/about/): Product overview, features, security, and platform availability.
- [For Work](https://workspace.google.com/products/gmail/): Gmail for Google Workspace with business email and collaboration features.
- [Download Gmail](https://www.google.com/gmail/about/): Official product page with links to mobile app availability.

## Help Center
- [Gmail Help Center](https://support.google.com/mail/): Central support hub for Gmail setup, usage, and troubleshooting.
- [Get Started with Gmail](https://support.google.com/mail/topic/3394219): Introductory guides for using Gmail features and settings.
- [Fix a Problem](https://support.google.com/mail/topic/3394213): Troubleshooting articles for login, sync, delivery, and account issues.
- [Read & Organize Email](https://support.google.com/mail/topic/3394144): Help for inbox management, labels, filters, and search.
- [Settings](https://support.google.com/mail/topic/3394150): Documentation for signatures, forwarding, POP/IMAP, and general preferences.
- [Privacy & Security](https://support.google.com/mail/topic/3394218): Guidance for spam, phishing, suspicious activity, and account protection.

## Account & Security
- [Google Account](https://myaccount.google.com/): Manage personal info, security settings, and connected Google services.
- [Google Account Help](https://support.google.com/accounts/): Help for sign-in, recovery, verification, and account management.
- [Security Checkup](https://myaccount.google.com/security-checkup): Review account security settings, devices, and recent activity.
- [Password Manager](https://passwords.google.com/): Manage saved passwords associated with your Google Account.
- [2-Step Verification Help](https://support.google.com/accounts/topic/7189145): Setup and troubleshooting for two-factor authentication.
- [Account Recovery](https://accounts.google.com/signin/recovery): Recover access to a Google Account when sign-in fails.

## Workspace Admin
- [Admin Help Center](https://support.google.com/a/): Support hub for Google Workspace administrators managing Gmail and users.
- [Set Up Gmail for Work](https://support.google.com/a/topic/2683827): Admin setup guides for enabling Gmail in an organization.
- [Gmail Admin Settings](https://support.google.com/a/topic/2683868): Configure routing, compliance, spam, and user access policies.
- [Email Routing & Delivery](https://support.google.com/a/topic/2921034): Admin documentation for mail flow, routing, and delivery settings.
- [Vault for Gmail](https://support.google.com/vault/topic/2479278): Retention, holds, search, and export guidance for Gmail data.
- [Google Workspace Admin Console](https://admin.google.com/): Administrative console for managing Gmail and Workspace services.

## Developer
- [Gmail API Overview](https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api): Overview of the Gmail API, capabilities, and integration patterns.
- [Gmail API Reference](https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/reference/rest): REST reference for Gmail API resources, methods, and schemas.
- [Gmail API Guides](https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/guides): Guides for authentication, sending mail, labels, threads, and sync.
- [Gmail API Quickstarts](https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/quickstart): Language-specific quickstarts for calling the Gmail API.
- [Gmail API Samples](https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api/samples): Example code for common Gmail API tasks and workflows.
- [Gmail Add-ons](https://developers.google.com/workspace/add-ons/gmail): Build Gmail add-ons that extend the Gmail user interface.
- [Apps Script Gmail Service](https://developers.google.com/apps-script/reference/gmail): Reference for automating Gmail with Google Apps Script.

## IMAP, POP, and SMTP
- [Check Gmail Through Other Email Platforms](https://support.google.com/mail/answer/7126229): Official settings for accessing Gmail via IMAP, POP, and SMTP.
- [Read Gmail Messages on Other Email Clients Using POP](https://support.google.com/mail/answer/7104828): Enable and configure POP access for external email clients.
- [Check Gmail Through Other Email Clients with IMAP](https://support.google.com/mail/answer/7126229): Enable and configure IMAP access for desktop and mobile clients.
- [Send Email from a Printer, Scanner, or App](https://support.google.com/mail/answer/7126229): SMTP-related guidance for sending through Gmail infrastructure.
- [Less Secure Apps and Google Account Access](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/6010255): Security guidance affecting legacy app access to Google accounts.

## Policies & Privacy
- [Gmail Program Policies](https://support.google.com/mail/answer/81126): Rules and restrictions for acceptable Gmail usage.
- [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy): How Google collects, uses, and protects user data.
- [Google Terms of Service](https://policies.google.com/terms): Terms governing use of Google products including Gmail.
- [Google Workspace Security](https://workspace.google.com/security/): Security and compliance information relevant to Gmail for organizations.
- [Transparency Report](https://transparencyreport.google.com/): Public reporting on requests, disruptions, and platform safety information.

## Accessibility & Training
- [Gmail Accessibility](https://support.google.com/mail/topic/2786039): Accessibility help for screen readers, keyboard shortcuts, and usability.
- [Gmail Keyboard Shortcuts](https://support.google.com/mail/answer/6594): Reference for keyboard commands in Gmail.
- [Google Workspace Learning Center](https://support.google.com/a/users/): End-user training resources for Gmail and Workspace apps.
- [Gmail Cheat Sheet](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9300022): Quick reference for common Gmail tasks and shortcuts.
- [Switch from Microsoft Outlook to Gmail](https://support.google.com/mail/topic/9117387): Migration-oriented guidance for users moving from Outlook.

## Community
- [Gmail Community](https://support.google.com/mail/community): Community forum for Gmail questions and peer support.
- [Google Workspace Admin Community](https://support.google.com/a/community): Community support for administrators managing Gmail in Workspace.
- [Google Workspace Updates Blog](https://workspaceupdates.googleblog.com/): Official product update announcements affecting Gmail and Workspace.
- [Google Blog](https://blog.google/): Broader Google news, announcements, and product updates including Gmail.
